prompt: Products live in individual hashes, and the catalog must answer: which products have color=red? Which modeling approach delivers that query?
explanation: Redis has no query engine, so secondary indexes are modeled explicitly: one set per attribute value, such as idx:color:red, holds the ids of every product carrying that value. SMEMBERS reads the matches and SINTER intersects several attribute sets for AND queries.

options.text: Keep one set per attribute value, for example SADD idx:color:red 1 2 3, holding the product ids that carry the value
Scan every product hash at query time and filter for the color field
Store all products in one list and filter client-side
Use a sorted set of product ids scored by product id
